name: setsid
description: setsid() creates a new session and makes the calling process its leader, provided it is not already a process group leader. It also sets the calling process as the leader of a new process group, ensuring it is the only process in both the new session and process group.

return_value.success: Returns the new session ID of the calling process
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The calling process is already a process group leader
